perks.name: Field Prep
perks.desc: Increases ammo generation. Faster reload, stow, and ready speed when you're crouching.

perks.name: Hip-Fire Grip
perks.desc: Increases accuracy, stability, and precision hit targeting when firing from the hip.

perks.name: Perpetual Motion
perks.desc: This weapon gains bonus stability, handling, and reload speed while the wielder is in motion.

perks.name: Keep Away
perks.desc: Increases reload, range, and accuracy when no targets are in close proximity.

perks.name: Envious Assassin
perks.desc: Defeating targets with other weapons before drawing this one transfers ammo to the magazine from reserves. This effect can overflow the magazine based on the number of targets defeated.

perks.name: Reconstruction
perks.desc: This weapon slowly reloads itself over time, up to double capacity.

perks.name: Rewind Rounds
perks.desc: When this weapon's magazine is empty, it refills from reserves based on the number of hits.

perks.name: Burning Ambition
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage scorches the target. Dealing damage to a scorched target inflicts scorch.

perks.name: Collective Demolition
perks.desc:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of grenade energy generation on hit. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.

perks.name: Frenzy
perks.desc: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon until you are out of combat.

perks.name: Harmony
perks.desc: Final blows with other weapons improve this weapon's damage and performance for a short duration.

perks.name: High-Impact Reserves
perks.desc: Rounds at the end of the magazine deal more damage.

perks.name: Target Lock
perks.desc: Damage increases the longer this weapon remains on a target.

perks.name: Paracausal Affinity
perks.desc: Final blows of energy types matching this weapon's alignment grant increased damage for a short period of time. Light final blows boost Arc, Solar, and Void weapons. Darkness final blows boost Stasis and Strand weapons.

perks.name: Vorpal Weapon
perks.desc: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active.

perks.name: Incandescent
perks.desc:
Defeating a target spreads scorch to those nearby.
More powerful combatants and opposing Guardians cause scorch in a larger radius.

perks.name: Detonator Beam
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage creates an explosion around the target.

perks.name: Chaos Reshaped
perks.desc: This weapon gains bonus damage while in combat for an extended time. Remaining in combat for even longer rewards a larger damage bonus and periodically heals the wielder.

notes: pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): Recommended MW: Reload. Adaptive(1000) Solar Trace Rifle Special Ammo. "Acacia's Dejection is a super fun trace rifle with Reconstruction and Target Lock. Paracausal Affinity is great for instant 20 percent damage. Depending on what you’d like to use this trace rifle for you can either blitz majors and champs with it or clear out rooms of enemies with incredible damage. I would definitely farm for this trace rifle."

pandapaxxy (PvP / Controller): Recommended MW: Range. Adaptive(1000) Solar Trace Rifle Special Ammo. "In PvP there’s a lot less to talk about. Trace rifles are beefed up auto rifles but lack ammo. Target Lock will melt your enemies as long as you're accurate. The one bonus is perfect hip-fire accuracy as you are looking at the trace."

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies Podcast vs Enemies episode 57 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/3LOWj7jLe0eiacDYwEbK22) with @CourtProjects, @ImpetusAlways and @Saint_Kabr. First-choice PvE roll for Minor add-clear in end-game content. Most Raid weapons boast stellar stat packages, and Acasia's Dejection is no different - this is the best legendary trace rifle as at v7.0.0.6. The recoil is already pretty easy to control with 96 Recoil Direction and 80 stability, so your barrel and battery choices are more of a bonus than gap filler. You can use this as a pseudo primary weapon with Field Prep as your first trait column support perk boosting your reserves, and Frenzy as your second column signature perk not only boosting damage by 15%, but capping out Handling and Reload Speed at 100. The Harmonic Resonance origin trait can boost damage still further by a stacking 3.33% with one other RoN Raid weapon or 10% with two. Recommended MW: Range or Stability - just go with your preference, with a damage-boosting (Minor or Taken Spec) or Backup Mag mod
